Mydei feels something soft brush against his cheek, causing him to nuzzle his face deeper into his pillow. He hears a breathy giggle come from slightly above him, but tries to ignore it in favor of going back to sleep. His body feels exhausted after the last few days he’s had.

“Love,” a familiar voice whispers as an accompanying hand brushes Mydei’s hair out of his face. “Wake up,” the voice says warmly.

Mydei peeks an eye open to find his smiling mate looking back at him as they lie closely together in their shared bed. Phainon is naked and lying on his side, supporting his weight with one of his forearms as he continues to pet Mydei’s hair. His bottom half is covered only by their blankets, with the omega being in a similar state. Mydei unintelligibly grumbles to himself before finally removing his face from the pillow and looking at Phainon with both eyes now.

“What time is it?” Myde asks, voice groggy after experiencing such deep sleep. He yawns, leisurely rubbing at his eyes.

Phainon grins as he watches him. “It’s a couple of hours past noon now,” he says, letting his hand go still on Mydei’s head, holding the omega tenderly.

Mydei’s eyes widen. He’d been sleeping for that long?! He’s usually an early riser, but his body must have needed the extra sleep…

“How long have you been up?” Mydei asks. He takes a better look at his alpha now that the sleepy haze is out of his eyes, only to find that he looks utterly refreshed. Meanwhile, Mydei feels like he could knock out for another ten hours.

“Hmm, since about mid-morning.”

“And you’ve just been watching me sleep this whole time?”

Phainon laughs brightly and briefly leans into Mydei to brush his cheek against the omega’s head, scenting him. “Well, of course. What else would I be doing right now? My day’s been quite lovely so far, I’ll have you know,” he quips.

“How nice for you, meanwhile you’re the reason everything hurts,” Mydei grumbles, sore all over.

“Oh, Mydeeei,” Phainon coos, leaning down to kiss him on the forehead. “I’m sorry,” he says sincerely. The alpha’s invisible dog ears point downward as he fusses over Mydei. “How are you feeling? Do you need anything?” he asks, eyes wide with concern.

The mated pair’s shared estrus cycle finally broke last night after locking themselves in their home for three days. After mating, like any pair, their heat and rut started to sync up so that they may spend their cycles more…efficiently. Phainon must have cleaned them up after Mydei fell asleep, considering how non-sticky he feels at the moment. Before Phainon was his, waking up alone after his heats was such a pain, but now Mydei has his mate to truly treat him like a goddess. However, they are both going to have to clean up the messes and various broken things around the house now…

Mydei’s heart can’t help but feel warm from how sweet his alpha is. “Gosh, I’m fine. I was just exaggerating.” He attempts to console Phainon by giving him a sweet kiss on the lips. “I’m really okay, don’t worry.”

It seems to do the trick.

“Okay,” his alpha sighs happily, leaning in for another kiss that Mydei easily grants.

“Is there reasoning behind why you were more worked up than usual?” Mydei inquires, needing an explanation for the extra reserve of energy Phainon had during his rut this time.

“What, I can’t be excited? I feel just beside myself with joy, Mydei, I can’t help it,” he nearly squeals, the energy and excitement lighting up behind his eyes.

Mydei laughs. “No, I understand. I’m equally excited,” he agrees, reaching out to trace his fingers over the mating bite he left on Phainon’s neck all that time ago. It sits prettily on the opposite side of his sun symbol. Phainon had stopped wearing his black leather choker after mating so that Mydei’s bite could be easily seen by everyone. It’s quite abnormal in Okhema for the alpha to also be bitten, but it’s downright expected in Castrum Kremnos. Though it didn’t come as a surprise to Mydei that his alpha wanted to show off his bite.

This recent shared cycle was special because it’s their first time trying for a baby! Mydei recently stopped the birth control that Hyacine’s been prescribing him in preparation for this. They’re finally going to have a family together and they couldn’t be happier. So happy, in fact, that Phainon didn’t let him go for a single second. The alpha’s passion was intense enough to have Mydei question whether or not he’d survive. It seems that the idea of getting Mydei pregnant (for real this time) was truly an all-consuming thought for Phainon. Mydei’s memories from his heat cycles tend to dwindle once they end, but for this past cycle, he remembers every other sentence that came from his alpha’s mouth being about impregnating him.

After making the initial decision to try for a baby, they went to Hyacine to relay the information and get a consultation. She gave them lots of advice and even sent Mydei home with some fertility supplements. Although Mydei was too prideful to actually take them…

(If this time doesn't work, then he supposes he’ll try them for their next cycle.)

Phainon wraps his arms tightly around Mydei’s shoulders and nuzzles into the back of his neck. His happy scent fills the air around them. “Do you think it worked?”

Mydei sighs. “You really can’t wait a week?”

“I’ve been waiting for years at this point, a week is haaard,” Phainon whines, briefly squeezing the omega in his hold to emphasize his point.

“You’ll survive.”

“If you kiss me again.”

Mydei turns his head back to look at the dopey grin on his mate’s face.

He kisses him.

So, directly following the events of their first time together, he dragged himself and Phainon to Hyacine in order to acquire an anti-fertilization remedy.

Since neither of them could have guessed they’d be spending Mydei’s heat together, they had no preparations in place to account for the (very real) possibility of pregnancy. And, as previously stated, Mydei has never been against the idea of having Phainon’s baby, but he knew it wasn’t the right time for that when their relationship was still so new.

“I thought we shared everything with each other,” Mydei gently accuses.

“I was scared to know the truth, in the case that you really don’t want pups with me.”

“You have nothing to fear, for I couldn’t imagine my pups having any other father than you. I want that for us.”

It was that same line of thinking that had given Mydei the courage to finally mate with Phainon.

Mydei’s labor process unsurprisingly speeds up from there, and Phainon doesn’t leave his side for a second. Mydei insists the pain isn’t too bad, but then finds himself nearly breaking his mate’s hand from squeezing it too hard. And three hours later, their baby girl is born.

***

Phainon watches as the two most important people in his world sleep soundly in their bed. Mydei’s lying back against the pillows, his long hair spread out around him as their beautiful pup sleeps on his bare chest. She’s wearing a cloth diaper that nearly swallows her, and every now and again she makes a precious grunting or snorting sound. The alpha is lying next to them while propped up on his arm. He’s gently resting his hand on top of Mydei’s, that is placed on her tiny back. Their large hands basically cover her whole body.

Mydei’s face starts to twitch subtly as he slowly wakes up. He was so strong during delivery and followed Hyacine’s orders perfectly, but needed some well-deserved sleep after. Their little girl quickly tuckered herself out after crying too.

His mate’s eyes finally open fully and look down at their pup.

Phainon, as delicately as he can, brushes his fingers over her soft, blonde hair. “She looks just like you,” Phainon admires. “She’s perfect.” He kisses Mydei’s cheek.

Their little pup truly takes after her mother, from her blonde hair and golden eyes to her brows and nose. It’s like looking at Mydei as a baby, and Phainon adores her so much.

“Yeah,” Mydei agrees, smiling softly and still looking a little tired. “Maybe the next will look more like you.”

Phainon perks up at that. “The next?” he asks, tone hopeful.

Mydei doesn’t respond immediately and instead takes the time to brush his thumb over her little cheek. He bashfully looks over at the alpha before admitting, “…I want another one.”

Phainon laughs while trying to be mindful of the sleeping pup. “Whatever you want, sweetheart,” he agrees easily. Phainon looks at their pup again and leans in to softly kiss her head. “I never thought there’d be someone else in this world who I love as much as I love you.”

There’s some more silence after that. The two brand new parents are overcome with love as they look at the perfect little girl they created. But then, Phainon hears a sniffle and looks over to find his mate crying. The alpha feels like he’s stopped dead in his tracks. He’s never seen Mydei seriously cry before, in all the years they’ve known each other.

“I’m…,” Mydei starts, but needs to take a second to sniffle and try to blink away his tears. “I’m so happy,” he says.

Phainon feels his face crumple up as he coos and comforts his mate, taking his hand off his daughter to wipe away Mydei’s tears. “You deserve it, Mydei,” he says earnestly. “We’ll spend the rest of our lives together, as a family.”

Mydei nods as his tears dry up. “As a family,” he says quietly under his breath, as if amazed.

Phainon nuzzles his face into Mydei’s neck as he releases comforting pheromones, and his omega soon calms. It almost makes the alpha cry to think that his mate is truly his most vulnerable self around him. Phainon wouldn’t be surprised if Mydei hadn’t cried since he was a small child. (Meanwhile, Phainon has cried countless times just over the course of his omega’s pregnancy alone.) It makes Phainon want to protect him and love him forever, even more than previously.

A small, high-pitched sound comes from their pup, and Phainon looks down to see bright, golden eyes blinking at him.

“Ah, she’s awake,” Phainon whispers. “Hi, princess. Oh wait, I suppose she is technically a princess, huh?”

Mydei chuckles faintly. “You’re right. Can you hold her while I sit up?” he asks the alpha.

“Yes,” Phainon accepts, gently lifting her up off Mydei’s chest and making sure to support her head. He cradles her in his arms and smiles widely at her. “You’re so beautiful, like your mama. Oh! She’s smiling! I’m going to cry now.”

“Shut it,” Mydei grumbles, sitting up in bed so that his back’s straight. Phainon unenthusiastically hands his pup back to her mother.

There’s a sudden knock at the door.

“Yes?” Phainon calls.

Hyacine pokes her head in. “Are you ready for visitors?”

Phainon looks to his mate to make the call and see that Mydei nods. And soon Krateros, Castorice, and Tribios walk into the room, one after the other. They all gather around the bed (with Castorice standing back at the very end of it) as they gaze upon Mydei and Phainon’s pup.

“She’s so precious!” Castorice coos, clasping her hands together.

“What’s her name, De?” Tribbie inquires, standing closest to Mydei.

“Eirini, meaning peace.”

“That’s perfect for her!” Trianne cheers.

“She’s a mini Mydei! How cute,” Trinnon chimes in.

Krateros chuckles with pride. “Kremnoan genes are as strong as its people of course.”

Castorice then asks, “Will she acquire red markings like Mydei’s?”

“Members of the royal family usually get them once they’re a few years old. Mydeimos’ came in after he was about two,” Krateros answers with a nod.

“Do you want to hold her, Krateros?” asks Mydei.

The old alpha’s eyes widen. “Oh uh, I—um…I don’t know if I should,” he says, unsure of himself.

“You definitely should!“ Phainon encourages. “She’s your new princess after all.”

“Princess Eirini!” Tribbie exclaims.

“Ah, alright,” Krateros concedes. Mydei carefully hands her over to him, making sure the transfer is as safe as possible. The man looks down at her anxiously at first, but is soon charmed. “What a little gem,” he grins.

“My mate made the most perfect pup,” Phainon boasts, kissing his omega’s cheek.

Mydei leans into him. “I couldn’t have done it without you.”

“Ew,” blurts Trianne.

Epilogue

“Is this one good, mama?“ Eirini asks, holding out a pomegranate.

“Love, how about this one?” Phainon asks, also holding out a pomegranate.

They’re doing some grocery shopping in Marmoreal Market this morning, and Mydei’s two assistants are trying to pick out good pomegranates from the vendor's stall. Mydei can’t help but smile at the picture the two make: Phainon holding their four-year-old on his hip so that she could reach, and them both holding out their fruit to him. The alpha, who was raised in a farming town and should definitely know a good fruit from a bad fruit by now, presents an obviously unripe pomegranate.

Mydei plays along with their competition and grabs the two fruits, weighing them in his hands before putting Eirini’s in his basket for purchase and Phainon’s back with the other fruits.

The little omega cheers happily over having her pomegranate chosen by her mama. “Papa’s bad at this,” Eirini says, laughing.

Mydei smiles at his mate, who always plays along with their pup. “I agree, Eirini.”

Phainon guffaws as if shocked. “Papa’s not bad, I’m just no match against someone with your talent,” he says to Eirini before attacking her face with kisses.

Their daughter laughs and screams as she tries to escape from her papa’s fierce attack, her long, blonde, and crimson hair shaking around wildly. Okhemans look fondly at the father and daughter duo as they pass by. Mydei smiles tenderly at his family, but then catches sight of another vendor he wants to purchase from.

“Wait, papa, look!” Eirini tries to get the attention of Phainon. “Mama’s leaving!” she says worriedly, wanting her father to catch up to him.

Mydei’s little omega seems to have separation anxiety, so she needs to be near him always. She always cries when she has to be babysat by Tribbie or Hyacine when they have their shared estrus cycle. Cipher says she follows him around like a duck, and Mydei can’t deny that. Although Hyacine says she’ll grow out of it. Mydei sometimes worries that it makes his mate disappointed or jealous that Eirini tends to favor her mama over her papa, but Phainon assures him that he thinks it’s cute.

The alpha quickly catches up to Mydei, and they finish up their grocery shopping before heading back home for Eirini’s nap time, leaving them to put the groceries away.

“Are you excited for our appointment?” asks Phainon as he finally stores away the last item from their grocery bags.

They have an appointment scheduled with Hyacine today after Phainon was sure, yet again, that he could smell a pregnancy scent on Mydei. They just shared their last cycle a week and a half ago after deciding to try for another baby. They almost decided to have their second child two years ago when Eirini was only two, but then figured they should get a better handle on parenthood before actually going through with it.

“I know you are,” Mydei smirks at him from where he’s leaning back against their countertop. “Probably looking forward to me bringing the maternity chiton out from retirement.”

After Mydei lost the baby weight, he went back to his usual attire, but Algaea did have to make some adjustments to accommodate the changes in his…curves. He doesn’t wrap his chest anymore, but he did while he was still nursing their pup, which Phainon appreciated because he knew first-hand how full with milk the omega’s breasts would get. (He might’ve even helped reduce the oversupply issue that Mydei would run into.)

Phainon chuckles, approaching Mydei to wrap his arms around his waist. “Well, I can’t deny that. I also think it’ll be just darling to see Eirini be a big sister.”

Mydei smiles at the thought as he wraps his arms around his mate's neck. “That also excites me. I just hope she’ll get along with them.”

“You think they’ll fight over you?”

“I hope not,” Mydei says, then sighs exasperatedly. “You two do that enough.”

Phainon scoffs before claiming, “I disagree! I just act how I always do with you, and then she tries to upstage me. It’s completely one-sided!”

“Shhh,” Mydei hushes him. “She's still sleeping.”

“Sorry,” Phainon whispers, eyes wide.

But then, they hear a pitter-patter coming from the other side of their house. Mydei almost turns to scold Phainon, but remembers that they should be leaving for the Twilight Courtyard soon anyway. They both walk over to the living room, where they meet their little girl, who very clearly just woke up from a nap.

“Did you have a long enough nap, baby?” Mydei asks.

“Yeeowh,” Eirini says through a yawn, scratching at the red marking on her cheek. It looks pretty similar to Mydei’s, but on the opposite side of her face.

Phainon crouches down in front of her. “Mama and Papa have to go see Lady Hyacine right now. Do you want to come along or go play with Tribios?” he asks, brushing her messy hair back with his hand.

“I’m a big girl now!” she insists.

“Big girls can’t play with Tribios anymore? Lady Tribbie would be sad to hear you say that,” Phainon asks with a melancholic tone.

Eirini rushes to amend her statement. “N-no! I love Miss Tribbie! I just wanna see Big Ica.”

No matter how many times they tell her it’s ’Little Ica,’ she never says it right.

“I’m sure Ica wants to see you, too,” Phainon nods, standing up and holding out his hand for her to hold on their way there. “Okay, let’s go, princess.”

She shakes her head. “I want Mama to carry me.”

“I thought you were a big girl,” Mydei lightly challenges, but then Eirini looks at him with big, teary eyes and pouty lips, and he concedes. “I’m only teasing, of course I’ll carry you. Mama will carry you for as long as you want.” He bends down to pick her up, the little omega immediately latching on to him.

She may look like Mydei, but she certainly takes after her father in other ways. And, unsurprisingly, Mydei can’t deny her either.

“Can Mama carry me too?“ Phainon pouts at him now.

“Get your own Mama,” Eirini tells him, this time with an angry pout.

Phainon wraps an arm around Mydei’s hips and kisses him on the cheek. “Mama was mine first, I’ll have you know,” he brags.

Eirini sees that as a provocation and kisses Mydei’s other cheek. “He’s mine now!“

Mydei laughs and shakes his head at them. “You heard the princess,” he tells Phainon, grabbing his hand for their journey. “Let’s be off now.”

They soon arrive at the Twilight Courtyard to see Hyacine and find themselves repeating the same process from over four years ago now. Except this time, their daughter is sitting on Phainon’s lap as the couple hold hands, anticipating the glowing light of Hyacine’s scepter. Eirini doesn’t really know why they’re here, but she seems entranced by the blue orb as it spins rapidly. And finally, a bright light, even brighter than before, shines brilliantly.

“Congratulati—oh! Ah, congratulations, it’s twins!” Hyacine announces.

Mydei and Phainon both turn to each other with huge smiles on their faces. It seems their family is expanding a lot faster than they expected.
